title: Flight
description:
You give up the fight and think of nothing but getting out alive.

Only player characters can play {{FUITEX-001|this Skill}}. You can play it only while you are in combat.

Your {{vitesse}} is tripled, and all your {{jet|Rolls}} suffer 5 {{desavantage|Disadvantages}}. While {{FUITEX-001}} lasts, a natural result of 3 or less on the kept {{jet|Roll}} produces a {{echec-critique}}.
